items.name: Rich Text Editor
items.description: A toolbar-style rich text editor built on Tiptap with shadcn/ui tokens. Built on Tiptap — installs @tiptap/* as dependencies.

items.name: Block Editor
items.description: A Notion-style block editor built on Tiptap with shadcn/ui tokens. Built on Tiptap — installs @tiptap/* as dependencies.

items.name: Static Renderer
items.description: Read-only rendering and styling for HTML produced by editor and block-editor. Built on Tiptap — installs @tiptap/* as dependencies.

items.name: Image Placeholder
items.description: A Notion-style image placeholder node that lets you upload or embed an image by URL, with a resizable image node view and its own toolbar button. Built on Tiptap — installs @tiptap/* as dependencies.

items.name: Table
items.description: A table node with a toolbar that inserts tables from a grid-size picker, lets you add or delete rows and columns, merge and split cells, toggle the header row, and manage rows and columns from hover context handles. Columns are resizable and a gap cursor is included by default. Built on Tiptap — installs @tiptap/* as dependencies.

items.name: Mention
items.description: An @ picker that inserts inline mention nodes with a stable id and label. Items load from a sync or async source with debounce, loading and empty states, and keyboard navigation. Backspace removes the whole mention. Built on Tiptap — installs @tiptap/* as dependencies.

items.name: Markdown
items.description: Load, store, and paste markdown. Wraps the official Tiptap markdown extension so editor.getMarkdown() and contentType: "markdown" work, adds an opt-in pasteMarkdown option, and ships a toolbar button to import, export, or copy markdown. Built on Tiptap — installs @tiptap/* as dependencies.

items.name: Paste Cleanup
items.description: Cleans HTML pasted from Google Docs, Notion, Word, and web pages. Strips classes, ids, fonts, and colors, keeps bold, italic, underline, and links, turns Word list paragraphs into real nested lists, and drops empty paragraphs. Built on Tiptap — installs @tiptap/* as dependencies.

items.name: Callout
items.description: Info, tip, warning, danger, and note boxes that hold rich content. Switch the type or remove the callout from its icon menu, insert one from a toolbar button, or type > [!NOTE] to create one. Round-trips as GitHub alert syntax in markdown. Built on Tiptap — installs @tiptap/* as dependencies.

items.name: Code Block
items.description: A Notion-style code block with Shiki syntax highlighting, a searchable language menu, copy, wrap toggle, captions, Prettier formatting, and a live Mermaid diagram preview. Code stays editable in the editor, so undo and collaboration keep working. Built on Tiptap — installs @tiptap/* as dependencies.

items.name: Toggle
items.description: A Notion-style collapsible section that holds any block content, including other toggles. Click the triangle to collapse or expand, insert one from the slash menu or by typing +++ on an empty line, and press Enter in the title to jump into the content. The open state is saved with the document and native details HTML keeps it working in the static renderer without JavaScript. Built on Tiptap — installs @tiptap/* as dependencies.

items.name: Comment Box
items.description: A comment thread with avatars, relative times, emoji reactions, a delete menu, and an editor composer with onPost, onReact, and onDelete hooks. Built on Tiptap — installs @tiptap/* as dependencies.

items.name: Email Composer
items.description: An email card with To and Subject fields, a message body with bold, italic, underline, link and list controls, and Send and Discard buttons. onSend receives the body as Tiptap JSON. Built on Tiptap — installs @tiptap/* as dependencies.

items.name: Simple Document Editor
items.description: A document page with a breadcrumb header, collaborators, a floating toolbar, task lists, and a status bar with word count and shortcuts. Built on Tiptap — installs @tiptap/* as dependencies.

items.name: Full Toolbar Editor
items.description: The full toolbar editor from the editorcn homepage: every toolbar control plus callouts, code blocks, tables, images, embeds, mentions, Markdown and paste cleanup. Built on Tiptap — installs @tiptap/* as dependencies.

items.name: Full Block Editor
items.description: The full block editor from the editorcn homepage: a slash menu and drag handles plus callouts, toggles, code blocks, tables, images, task lists, mentions, Markdown and paste cleanup. Built on Tiptap — installs @tiptap/* as dependencies.
